transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
Um… mostly my eating, I guess. It’s been off. Some days before work I barely manage coffee and maybe a granola bar, and my scrubs are getting loose. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything.
Have you noticed yourself being particularly concerned about your weight or the way your body looks lately?
Not really about how I look, no. I just… haven’t been eating much. Some mornings it’s coffee and maybe a granola bar before work, and my scrubs are fitting looser. I’m not trying to lose weight.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to run over in Van Cortlandt, take pictures, play chess with some friends. Lately I just… don’t really see the point. I end up at home, scrolling or looking at my budget spreadsheet.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days, and if so, how long have you been feeling this way?
Yeah… most days, I’d say. It kind of settled in after a while, the feeling down and not caring about much. It’s been… maybe a year and four months now.
Have you experienced any other changes, like trouble sleeping, feeling guilty, having trouble concentrating, or feeling hopeless?
Yeah… sleep’s been off. I’ll lie there going over stuff from work, kind of listening for noises, and then I’m up around 3 or 4. After that I don’t really get back to sleep before the alarm.
Have you found it harder to focus on tasks, make decisions, or think clearly lately?

Yeah… sometimes. At work, even with simple intake stuff, I’ll start answering and then I’m talking about the EMR screen, then staffing, then some licensure thing I read… and I can tell by their faces I kind of lost the point. It’s embarrassing, so I try to keep it short.
Have you felt more tired or like you don’t have the energy to do things you need or used to do?
Yeah… I get tired a lot. Even if I was in bed all night, my body feels like I just finished a double shift. By lunch I’m kind of dragging and trying to keep my thoughts together.
Have you completely lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like running or playing chess with your friends?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to run in Van Cortlandt, take pictures sometimes, play chess with friends. Lately I just… don’t see the point. I end up at home scrolling or checking my budget spreadsheet instead.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, that you're more restless or fidgety lately?

Yeah… both, kind of. At work I’ll catch myself pacing around the supply area, checking the same drawers over and over. Other times I’m just slow—like doing labels or answering a patient takes me way longer than it should.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living, or had thoughts about harming yourself?
I… I haven’t made any plan or anything like that. But yeah, sometimes I catch myself thinking it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up… or if I could just disappear for a while.
